digest.component_or_area: binding_store persistence and rotation state management
propositions: After successful new-writer save, the last_get_pass inline field must be absent from all entries in bindings.json while sidecar rotation state is persisted first
When sidecar persistence fails, the primary binding save must succeed with inline fields retained as a failure floor, enabling clean retry convergence
A crash occurring after sidecar replace but before bindings replace must not lose the chronological maximum rotation state, which must already be durable in the sidecar

Persistence must merge staged inline values into sidecar via chronological max, atomically persist get_rotation.json, then remove inline fields and write bindings.json only on successful sidecar persistence
An old-writer/new-writer sequence that reintroduces a later inline stamp must migrate that maximum into get_rotation.json before scrubbing the inline field
Rollback support must guarantee any A2-1-or-newer binary can read both inline and sidecar rotation forms, with pre-A2-1 rollback prohibited after the deployment gate
